_about: Play Data safety answers for the Android app (com.universalsim.extender). Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Screens/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Screens/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-10-12: the screen, input and device name go peer to peer on the LAN, end-to-end encrypted with the PIN (Noise), never to UNI·SIM. Remote codes and Cast to a browser pass through the opensource.unisim.co.uk rendezvous relay, which forwards messages and stores nothing (remote sessions are end-to-end encrypted; cast commands are TLS-encrypted and processed ephemerally), so not declared as collected. No user count, analytics or crash reporting in the Android app (UserCount.kt removed 2026-10-12). Sign-in is optional, LOGIN ONLY with an emailed code (accounts are made on app.unisim.co.uk, never in the app, hence PSL_ACM_NONE): email + account id. Saved-computer sync to screens_saved_hosts is opt-in ("Sync saved computers to my account", unticked; unticking deletes the uploaded rows): each computer's LAN address, name, OS, the user's nickname and last-connected time, never the PIN — declared as Other user-generated content, optional, App functionality. Saved computers can also move between devices as a file the user saves and opens themselves (SavedFile.kt, the suite transfer envelope, never the PIN, added 2026-10-20); it never reaches UNI·SIM, so it adds nothing here. Mirrors PRIVACY.md and apps/ios/ScreenExtender/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy (the iOS app has no sign-in and collects nothing).
